svg.aria-label: Position, velocity and acceleration profiles for three trajectory types
svg.text: Trajectory profiles — cubic, quintic and S-curve
Same 1-unit move over the same duration; time is normalised to 0…1 in each panel.
The cubic has a velocity step-free but finite-jerk start; the quintic is 25% faster at mid-move and acceleration-continuous; the S-curve limits jerk, so its acceleration leaves zero smoothly.
